A cylinder Chernoff upper bound, independent tilted-digit laws and bounded-variable strong law give matching dimension h(c)/log3; the triadic ball/cylinder boundary estimate supports the Euclidean Hausdorff lower bound. At endpoints use maximizing branches, with entropy p log2 and (1-p)log2. P is strictly convex with P′(0)=(4p-2)/3; p=0,1 and exceptional countably many boundary codes are covered. Independent rational inverse-branch and winding calculation checked 9,330 finite histories over both forcing letters, n=1..5. This checks the algebra, not the infinite strong law or dimension claim.
